answer_1.quote: This work investigates exploiting LLMs for MT at both sentence and document levels.

answer_2.quote: Regarding metrics, we employ various methods to assess the quality at both the sentence and document levels. Our report includes BLEU , ChrF2  using Sacre-BLEU , and COMET 3  scores for sentence-level evaluation. To gauge the quality of word prediction using contextual information at the document level, we report Precision, Recall, and F1 scores for words detected by the MuDA tagger.
